# founder of

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:founderOf`](gmeow-founderOf.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/founderOf>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates an agent to an organization it founded. Inverse of [`gmeow:foundedBy`](gmeow-foundedBy.md). Non-functional — an agent may found several organizations.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when traversing or projecting from a founder to the organizations they founded — the agent-rooted direction.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting [`gmeow:founderOf`](gmeow-founderOf.md) directly when the organization's perspective is natural — assert [`gmeow:foundedBy`](gmeow-foundedBy.md) and read this as its inverse — and avoid it where the founding date matters (use a founding [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md)).

### How to use

- Prefer asserting [`gmeow:foundedBy`](gmeow-foundedBy.md) and let [`gmeow:founderOf`](gmeow-founderOf.md) follow by inversion; reach for it explicitly only in agent-rooted projections.
